lib/ai/bridge.ts.name: Ask AI bridge
lib/ai/bridge.ts.description: Keeps a listener set so a button outside the chat panel can send it an Ask AI prompt, and reports whether a panel is listening.

lib/ai/chat-request.ts.name: Chat request guard
lib/ai/chat-request.ts.description: Rejects a chat request that is unconfigured, cross-origin, over 32 KB or 20 messages, or off the message schema.

lib/ai/events.ts.name: Chat analytics events
lib/ai/events.ts.description: Sends chat panel events to PostHog under the inkeep_ names lib/inkeep.ts uses, with the component type and never message text.

lib/ai/inkeep-qa-schema.ts.name: Inkeep tool schemas
lib/ai/inkeep-qa-schema.ts.description: Declares the Zod schemas for Inkeep's provideLinks and provideAIAnnotations tool calls: source links and answer confidence.

lib/inkeep.ts.name: Inkeep widget settings
lib/inkeep.ts.description: Builds the shared Inkeep search and chat settings (brand colour, cookie opt-outs, no Google Fonts) and forwards widget events to PostHog.
